sources.observations: Displayed textured 3D at headings0,84.6,169.2,253.8, pitch39.48; then overhead. Front shallow cross-roof, broad middle roof, rear raised pier-side roof and raised small pier-side box. Service strip behind, parking north, pier south.
Cream frontage, scalloped parapet, eight arches, brick piers/red glazing, Silcocks FUNLAND/SOUTHPORT PIER sign, white carousel roof offset pierwards.
North elevation cream upper panels, white horizontal lower cladding, two doors beneath shallow fascia; blank middle upright panel, scattered vents, red/blue lettering.
Rear cream wall and Silcocks FUNLAND sign; lower rear service strip screened by wall. Hidden contents omitted.
Near frontal measured ratios; eight scallops above four broad shopfront divisions, main centre door. Modern blue sub-sign absent; not copied historical advertising.
Pier-side raised box, five small upper windows plus door/balcony landing, low glazed linking range. Recessed panels; Hall of Mirrors sign is historic and omitted.
Rear hall pier side has repeated vertical ribs and FUNLAND & PIER lettering above low screened service walkway.
Low linking shopfront corroborated, several tiles blurred/unavailable, unsuitable for fine measurement.
Front and offset carousel displayed, corroborates roof silhouette; map panel failed, photograph eventually displayed.
